_comment: Synthetic co-location eval for the interpret/grouping system. Each thought belongs to an expected group; the test asks whether same-group thoughts end up sharing a theme (co-locate in one current) while different-group thoughts do not. 'expectedTheme' is a human label for the readout only — scoring is purely structural (shared theme strings), never a match against this word. Thoughts are interleaved on purpose so theme reuse is tested across gaps, not just back-to-back. lang drives which currency of theme we expect reuse within (bilingual proof: food-zh must unify on its own).
